label: 0019 · Starter, 50 km BEL cut, Nankai afterslip after the 2024 Hyuga-nada earthquake with a -20 floor and 30 km smoothing, CMT catalog through May 2025, UNR positions (exploratory MCMC)
description: starter_belcut50_m99_cmt25_unr (0018) with Nankai coupling bounds [-20, 1] (sigmoid slope 15, so the prior is unchanged down to -1.5) and a 30 km Matern length scale with 501 modes (instead of 79 km and 44 modes) after the 2024-08-08 Hyuga-nada Mw 7.1. Only Aug 2024-May 2025 differ from 0018. The afterslip forms a compact patch of about 3,500 km2 at 19-38 km depth instead of 26,000 km2 from the trench to the base of the mesh. Its centroid is 7 km from the GCMT centroid in Aug-Dec 2024 and moves about 20 km north in 2025. Residual RMS within 100 km drops from 6.2 to 3.2 mm/yr, and the network-wide fit is unchanged. Nankai coupling at Kii drops from 0.53 to 0.43 in these windows. In a synthetic test, a 30 km patch at the hypocenter is recovered with this prior (correlation 0.75) but not with the 79 km one (0.23-0.31). A 20 km length scale tightens the patch slightly more with no change in fit.
